_comment: Add these statements to the meetrudi-lambda-runner role's inline policy so the tester
console can work. Console -> IAM -> Roles -> meetrudi-lambda-runner -> its inline policy
-> Edit -> JSON -> paste these two statements into the existing Statement array.
TesterConsoleMail: meetrudi-tester-api sends the verification and password-reset mails
through SES in eu-central-1. Scoped to the verified sender identity by the ses:FromAddress
condition, so a compromised function cannot send as anybody else.
The address below MUST match TesterMailFrom exactly. If they disagree, SES refuses every
send with AccessDenied and the only symptom a tester sees is a verification mail that never
arrives. Cohort sender as of 2026-08-28: support@meetrudi.eu.
TesterConsoleDeleteObjects: sessions and single-use email links are DELETED, not just
overwritten - a burnt link must stop existing so a replay cannot redeem it, and a killed
session must be gone rather than merely marked. The base role only grants Get/Put/List, so
this adds DeleteObject narrowed to the two prefixes that hold ephemeral state. Tester
profiles, feedback and conversations are deliberately NOT deletable by this role; erasure
lands in phase 2 as its own reviewed path.
